assumptions: These are the repo wizard defaults for Silva's Handyman. Desktop hub rates are not in GitHub — edit this file to match Cesar's live config.
Profit margin is applied on top of every cost line. Nothing is quoted at raw cost.
Materials get material markup first, then the same profit margin.
Labor unit rates are hard cost (not already-marked-up sell prices).
Siding product assumption: 16 ft LP SmartSide-style lap, ~8 in exposure, field-painted to match existing cream/off-white.
Chimney wrap area = height × assumed girth (default 8 ft). Height premium is in the chimney reinstall unit rate.
Dump fee is a 10-yard East Bay debris-box hard cost, separate from the $1,000 demo labor lump.
